hints.title: Universal Requirement Aggregation
hints.text: Condense all target requirements into a single profile holding the maximum required count of each character.

hints.title: Max Character Count Combination
hints.text: For each character a to z, the needed count is the maximum count of that character across all words in words2.

hints.title: Superset Filter Pass
hints.text: A candidate word in words1 is universal if its character count meets or exceeds the aggregated requirement profile for every letter.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Constant alphabet size (26) comparison per candidate.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every pair across words1 and words2 takes quadratic O(len(words1) * len(words2)) comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed 26-character frequency arrays require O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pre-aggregate words2 into a single maximum letter frequency vector.
